en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a paddle steamer or river barge in the foreground on a wide river. On the opposite bank stand rows of houses, industrial buildings with tall chimneys, and a water tower, lined with trees along the embankment. At the top in red Gothic-style print it reads "Strehla a. Elbe." on the left and "Riesaer Strasse." on the right, indicating the scene shows Riesaer Straße in Strehla on the Elbe River.
